newsitem.title: USA: Texas Utilities drops after downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Texas Utilities drops after downgrade.

text.p: Shares of Texas Utilities Co slipped further Wednesday after CS First Boston downgraded the stock to hold from buy.
Texas Utilities was down 1-1/8 to 36-7/8 and was one of the most heavily traded issues on the New York Stock Exchange.
Several Texas-based utilities have come under pressure recently amid a perceived shift in philosophy for a key Texas utility regulator, analysts said.

Last week, Judy Walsh of the Texas Public Utility Commission made comments at a rate hearing for Central & South West Corp that raised concern about the commission's position on stranded cost recovery, analysts said.

Everen Securities Inc and NatWest Securites Corp downgraded Texas Utilities last week, citing regulatory concerns. Everen cited "significant stranded investment risk in its Comanche Peak nuclear plant."
Houston Industries Inc was down 1/2 to 21-3/4 today. Central & South West was up 1/8 to 23-1/4.
